completed_checkpoint: COMPLETE.json; verify outputs[].sha256 and binding.driver_sha/binding.semantics_sha; do not select just by filename/mtime
row_identity: binding.request retains full source CSV row; request_values.json contains common identity columns

scalars.raw_supported_mean: mean before 90% gate, not an accepted fallback

profile.temperature_K: QC-gated temperature mean on joint T/q finite+SPvalid cells perlevel
profile.specific_humidity_kgkg: QC-gated SPECIFIC humidity mean on exactly same joint cells, never mixing ratio
profile.joint_Tq_valid_fraction: shared valid area / original200–800km atmospheric annulus, used by PI
profile.temperature_original_valid_fraction: individual T support metadata, not replacement for joint coverage
profile.humidity_original_valid_fraction: individual q support metadata, not replacement for joint coverage

entropy_metadata: entropy600_metadata.json; mean native entropy in0–100km saturated and100–300km actual domains; functions/core saturated support independent of measuredq

maps.coordinates: latitude descending native0.25deg; longitude unwrapped continuous native0.25deg
maps.process_file: native_process_800km.npz stores native gradients-derivedbudget fields and jointsupport

raw_cache: cache/native_fields/<canonical geometry hash>/<variable>.npz; embedded binding_json; OS byte-range locks guard concurrent temporal-halo access
source_profile_scope: new v5 fields use sameNativeSP mask and original geometric denominator, NaturalEarth10m SST uniformly; not an automatic restatement of old110m track means
authoritative_new_parser_guard: profiles lacking joint_Tq_valid_fraction or entropy600_metadata belong to earlier preserved pilots and must not be substituted for current completed profile outputs
